chunks: They said: "Are you bringing us with the truth, or are you of those who jest?"

key_terms.اللَّاعِبِينَ: Those who jest, play, or are not serious
key_terms.الْحَقِّ: The truth, reality, or divine veracity

ai.seo_question: What did the people ask the prophet about the nature of his message?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse captures the dismissive attitude of the disbelievers who reduced the weighty message of revelation to mere entertainment, reflecting a common motif in Quranic narratives where prophets are accused of madness or playfulness. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a test of faith, where the core of the message is accepted or rejected based on the audience's spiritual readiness rather than the clarity of the proof. This skepticism underscores the persistent challenge prophets faced in conveying divine truth to societies entrenched in materialism and arrogance.
